stops.title: Hosanna
stops.summary: Jesus rides into Jerusalem on a donkey while crowds lay down their coats and shout Hosanna.
stops.why: Kings rode in on warhorses. Jesus chose a donkey, fulfilling the prophecy of a humble king. The same city that cheered Him that day would shout "Crucify him" a few days later. Crowds change. He didn't.

quiz.q: What did Jesus ride into Jerusalem?
What did people spread on the road?

stops.title: The King Kneels
stops.summary: On His last night, Jesus takes a towel and washes His disciples' feet.
stops.why: Washing feet was a servant's job, the lowest one in the house. Jesus did it knowing one of those men would betray Him that night. Then He said, "I have given you an example." Real leadership kneels.

quiz.q: What did Jesus use to dry their feet?
"I have given you an example, that ye should do as I have done to you."

stops.title: Barabbas Goes Free
stops.summary: Pilate finds no fault in Jesus, but the crowd demands a murderer's release instead.
stops.why: Barabbas was guilty and walked free. Jesus was innocent and took his place. That's the whole gospel in one scene. Every one of us is Barabbas in this story.

quiz.q: Who did the crowd ask to have released?
What did Pilate say about Jesus?
options: He found no fault in Him

quiz.q: What did the crowd keep shouting?

stops.title: Father, Forgive Them
stops.summary: Between two criminals, Jesus forgives His executioners and promises paradise to a dying thief.
stops.why: While nails were going in, Jesus prayed for the men driving them. And a criminal with hours to live, who had nothing to offer, asked to be remembered. He was promised paradise that same day. It's never too late while you're still breathing.

card.name: The Thief
card.title: The Last-Minute Believer
card.strength: Confessed Jesus as King while dying beside Him.
card.weakness: A criminal who admitted he deserved his sentence.

quiz.q: "Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do."
What did Jesus promise the criminal who asked to be remembered?
"Father, into thy hands I commend my spirit."

stops.title: He Is Not Here
stops.summary: An angel rolls back the stone, the guards faint, and the women hear the news: He is risen.
stops.why: Rome sealed the tomb and posted soldiers. It didn't matter. The angel didn't roll the stone away to let Jesus out. He rolled it away so everyone could see in. The grave was already empty.

options: They shook and became as dead men

quiz.q: "He is not here: for he is risen, as he said."
